title: Membranes
description: A cell is a bag: two layers of fat that water cannot cross, but ions can, through channels. Unlocks the Patch-Clamp Rig and Lipid Bilayers.

puzzle.goal: A sphere of radius r is wrapped in a skin two molecules thick. Write the skin's area A.
puzzle.name: Surface of a cell
puzzle.method: A sphere's surface is 4πr²; volume grows as r³, which is why cells stay small.
